conventions.rig: Mixamo skeleton from Sitting_Talking.fbx (65 bones), skeleton only, 30 fps, frames start at 1
conventions.facing: the umpire faces the rig's forward direction; turn him toward the scorers if you want signals shown to the scorebox
conventions.chaining: every signal clip starts and ends in the same neutral stance, so signals can be played back to back (e.g. no ball -> free hit, leg bye -> four)
conventions.signal_shown_frame: first frame the signal is fully made; signal_held_until_frame: last frame it is held
conventions.combinations: Laws: no ball then bye/leg bye if the ball was not hit, then four if it reached the boundary; free hit after the no-ball signal; revoke last signal to cancel a mistaken signal
conventions.not_included: third-umpire / TV referral and soft signals (not needed for now)
